title.en: An Act Authorizing Municipal Councils, the Municipal Board of Manila and the City Council of Baguio, to Grant Gratuities to the Members of the Police or their Families, in Certain Cases, and for Other Purposes.
title.orig: An Act Authorizing Municipal Councils, the Municipal Board of Manila and the City Council of Baguio, to Grant Gratuities to the Members of the Police or their Families, in Certain Cases, and for Other Purposes.

text.en:
Municipal councils, the Municipal Board of Manila and the city council of Baguio are hereby
authorized to grant a gratuity of not more than five hundred pesos, by appropriation from their available
general funds, to any members of the police of the municipality or city who has rendered faithful and efficient
service and has become disabled or has died in the line of duty, or to his family.

Before granting the gratuity provided for in the preceding section, the municipal council,
municipal board, or city council concerned may require the municipal president and the division health
officer, or the mayor and chief health officer of the city, as the case may be, to carefully investigate the cause
of the disability or death of the policeman in order to determine whether he actually contracted his disability
or death in the line of duty, and if after due investigation and medical advice it is found that the disability or
death of said policeman were due to this cause, he shall report the same to the council or board, as the case
may be, for the granting of a gratuity.

The provisions of this Act shall be applicable to the regular municipalities of Mindanao, Sulu,
and Palawan.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 2, 1930.
